meta_title: L.W. Gardening Services | Landscape Gardener Newcastle
meta_description: L.W. Gardening Services in Newcastle. Expert landscape gardening, garden design, and maintenance. Local family business serving Tyne & Wear. Get a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Local Family Business — 20+ Years in Tyne & Wear
hero_subhead: Transform your garden into a stunning outdoor space. From design to planting, we handle every detail so you can relax.
services_heading: Complete Landscape Gardening Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: Whether you need a full garden redesign, regular maintenance, or specialist planting, we've got the expertise and eye for detail.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: We listen to your vision and create a bespoke garden plan that maximises space and suits your lifestyle. From contemporary to cottage gardens, we design outdoor spaces that look stunning year-round.

services.title: Planting & Landscaping
services.desc: Expert selection and planting of shrubs, perennials, and trees tailored to Newcastle's climate. We use quality stock and proven techniques to establish healthy, vibrant gardens.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular maintenance keeps your garden looking its best. We offer weekly or fortnightly visits for hedge trimming, deadheading, weeding, and seasonal care.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: Professionally laid patios, decking, raised beds, and garden structures. We work with quality materials and ensure every installation is built to last.

services.title: Lawn Care & Renovation
services.desc: From lawn mowing to full renovation work, we restore tired lawns to lush, healthy turf. Scarification, aeration, and overseeding included.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Services
services.desc: Safe pruning, shaping, and removal of trees and established shrubs. We work to best practice standards and dispose of all waste responsibly.

about_pullquote: We treat every garden as if it's our own—that's the only way to do it right.
about_para_1: L.W. Gardening Services has been transforming gardens across Newcastle and Tyne & Wear for over 20 years. We started as a small family operation and have grown on the back of honest work and genuine care for every customer's outdoor space. Today we're known for combining skilled craftsmanship with creative design—whether we're building a new garden from scratch or breathing life back into tired borders.
about_para_2: Our customers come back year after year because we listen, we deliver, and we're always fair on price. We're not here to oversell or rush the job; we take time to understand what you want and make it happen. Many of our clients have been with us since day one, which tells you everything about the service we provide.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant. Our garden was a complete mess and we didn't know where to start. Lee came round, listened to what we wanted, and sorted it all out. The design looks beautiful and everything's been maintained perfectly since. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Had L.W. Gardening in to do a full garden overhaul including new patio and planting. Professional, tidy, and reasonably priced. They were here when they said they'd be and finished on time. Really happy with the result.
reviews.author: Janet M.

reviews.text: I've used them for regular maintenance for about five years now. They're reliable, hardworking, and they genuinely care about the garden. Never had any trouble with them. Would highly recommend to anyone in the area.
reviews.author: Tom W.
